history:
Terry Charles & His Music
Born at Thurmaston’s Main Street Post Office in 1931, Terry Charles Cockbill formed his own band during his teenage years – Terry Charles and His Music. 
They performed their popular dance tunes at pubs, clubs, hunt balls and American airforce bases.  Playing the piano and later the electric organ, the village Post Master was able to undertake a summer season at Butlin’s Minehead before his death in 1982.
